$$

$$
AB=\begin{bmatrix}9 \\ -1.3 \\ -2\sqrt{11}\end{bmatrix}.
$$

 

Let's check the long way:

$$
\begin{aligned}AB & =\begin{bmatrix}2\sqrt{6} & -7 & 9 \\ -1 & 4\sqrt{5} & -1.3 \\ 9 & 3 & -2\sqrt{11}\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix}0 \\ 0 \\ 1\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}2\sqrt{6}\cdot 0+(-7)\cdot 0+9\cdot 1 \\ (-1)\cdot 0+4\sqrt{5}\cdot 0+(-1.3)\cdot 1 \\ 9\cdot 0+3\cdot 0+(-2\sqrt{11})\cdot 1\end{bmatrix} \\  & =\begin{bmatrix}9 \\ -1.3 \\ -2\sqrt{11}\end{bmatrix}\end{aligned}
$$
